phase: Separate final language review after implementation and independent technical review
scope: UI wording in src/components, src/lib and src/data, plus README.md and src/content/docs/index.md.

recommendations.reason: The byte-count expansion repeats the meaning of MiB in every size error and distracts from the recovery action.
recommendations.preserve: Leave MAX_IMPORT_BYTES = 1024 * 1024 and all UTF-8/canonical-size checks unchanged.

recommendations.source_text: System files can be up to 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes). Your current system has been kept.
recommendations.replacement: System files can be up to 1 MiB. Your current system has been kept.
recommendations.reason: Use the same concise size limit in the browser file preflight.
recommendations.preserve: Keep the size check and current-system preservation message.

recommendations.reason: The exact byte expansion adds no useful action to this overview.
recommendations.preserve: Keep the saved-format qualification, over-limit edit handling, and recovery guidance. Detailed implementation remains byte-based.

recommendations.reason: Use the actual meaning of the date instead of the broader word verification.
recommendations.preserve: Execution status and documentation review remain distinct.

recommendations.source_text: automatically explore candidates that explain what they can find.
recommendations.replacement: see candidates and their documented checks.
recommendations.reason: Remove indirect wording while retaining the source of the candidate claims.
recommendations.preserve: The surrounding paragraph still explains inputs, optional details, persistence and workflow limits.

recommendations.source_text: Suggestions use reviewed workflows. These tools still have catalog notes but are not included in matching yet; their absence does not mean they are unsuitable:
recommendations.replacement: Suggestions use reviewed workflows. These tools are not matched yet but may still be suitable:
recommendations.reason: Shorten the omission explanation; the linked list already provides access to catalog notes.
recommendations.preserve: Omission must not imply incompatibility or unsuitability.

recommendations.source_text: Export system downloads a JSON file with the system name, components, connections, notes, and cost/license preferences. It excludes tool candidates, match explanations, comparison selections, and analysis results. Import restores the description and recalculates suggestions.
recommendations.replacement: Export saves your system name, components, connections, notes, and cost/license preferences as JSON. It excludes candidates, match explanations, comparison selections, and analysis results. Import restores the description and recalculates suggestions.
recommendations.reason: Lead with the action and remove repeated system/file wording.
recommendations.preserve: Retain the complete saved-field list, exclusions, and current-catalog recalculation behavior.

recommendations.source_text: These fields help you organize your system. They do not change suggestions.
recommendations.replacement: These fields organize your description and do not affect suggestions.
recommendations.reason: Combine the two short explanations without dropping the matching limitation.
recommendations.preserve: Optional descriptive fields must not appear to influence recommendations.

recommendations.source_text: Download recovery data to keep the existing saved copy. It may need correction or reduction before importing; it is not a normal system export. Importing another description or undoing an edit will keep this copy protected.
recommendations.replacement: Download recovery data to keep the saved copy. This is not a normal export; it may need correction or reduction before import. Imports and undo keep the saved copy protected.
recommendations.reason: Reduce repeated wording while preserving the recovery warning and overwrite protection.
recommendations.preserve: Keep the distinction from a normal export, possible repair/reduction, and protection through import/undo.

recommendations.source_text: Replace the saved system with the current description? Download recovery data first if you want to keep the existing saved copy.
recommendations.replacement: Replace the saved system with this description? Download recovery data first to keep the saved copy.
recommendations.reason: Make the confirmation shorter while retaining the explicit replacement and recovery action.
recommendations.preserve: The saved copy is replaced only through the existing explicit action.

recommendations.source_text: Automatic saving is paused because saved data could not be read. Retry reading saved data before saving. Current edits remain in memory.
recommendations.replacement: Saved data could not be read. Automatic saving is paused; current edits remain in memory. Retry reading saved data.
recommendations.reason: State the problem, protection and next action once each.
recommendations.preserve: Do not imply edits are saved or permit replacement before a successful storage read.

recommendations.source_text: Automatic saving is paused to protect the existing saved data. Download recovery data, then use Replace saved system if you want to save the current description instead.
recommendations.replacement: Automatic saving is paused to protect saved data. Download recovery data before choosing Replace saved system to save this description.
recommendations.reason: Remove repeated qualifiers and use the exact action label.
recommendations.preserve: Keep saving paused, recovery-download guidance, and explicit replacement semantics.

recommendations.source_text: Ruff checks lint rules. Pyright checks types and imports. Choose the checks you need; these tools can complement each other rather than replace one another.
recommendations.replacement: Ruff checks lint rules. Pyright checks types and imports. They provide complementary checks.
recommendations.reason: The specific tool roles already explain why both may be useful; the generic decision sentence repeats that point.
recommendations.preserve: Do not imply equal coverage or that either tool replaces runtime tests.

recommendations.source_text: Choose based on the question you need to answer and how much modeling you can provide.
recommendations.replacement: Choose based on your question and modeling effort.
recommendations.reason: Remove an indirect phrase without changing the decision factors.
recommendations.preserve: The surrounding CodeQL/JBMC summary retains query versus bounded-property distinctions.

recommendations.source_text: These are related products with distinct jobs. The catalog entry covers Code Prover; a trial does not count as a permanent free edition.
recommendations.replacement: This entry covers Code Prover. Its trial does not count as a free edition.
recommendations.reason: The product rows explain the different jobs; the introduction only needs to identify the entry and trial qualification.
recommendations.preserve: Keep the product-specific rows, required-products source and paid/trial distinction.

retained: 1 MiB enforcement, UTF-8 byte accounting and canonical saved-size checks.
Recovery warnings, explicit saved-data replacement, unsaved-edit status and import/undo protection.
Unknown-value versus compatibility-evidence actions and non-exhaustive support limits.
Accessible control names, live announcements and keyboard-focus instructions.
Docs checked meaning, execution labels, trial/eligibility qualifications, distinct analysis results and source evidence.
Catalog versus full-page search distinction and unchanged-filter notices.
no_change_notes: The catalog entry-point text is already brief and explains both tool choice and result interpretation.
Pagefind failure/development messages and scope caveats contain useful distinctions; no reductions recommended.
Avoid shortening Recorded requirements matched to Ready or Compatible; it would broaden the claim.
No changes recommended to schema values, stored v1 strings, URLs, commands, counts, date fields, or historical audit records.
validation: Every suggested source_text occurs exactly once in its recorded file; all replacements are ASCII. No product edits, build, browser or analyzer runs were performed.
